crossRefs.note: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

translations.web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
translations.bsb: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
translations.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
translations.asv: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.
